headline: The 10.1d preflight PASSED at entry (ram_free 19.35 GiB >= 12.0 floor) and the ON arm started, but under the flags REQUIRED_FLAGS mandates free RAM collapsed to 5.46 GiB with swap 8185/8191 MiB used, every recompose pass reloaded the 12.7 GB Qwen unet from disk, and the per-pass time went 385.66 s -> 677 s -> 609 s against a 900 s client budget. Halted after 2 of 33 shots (3 of 40 passes).

restart_preconditions_verified.checked_class_types: none — the queue was empty, so nothing belonging to another session was killed

comfyui.launcher: ~/workspaces/ComfyUI/run.sh, sed-rewritten in place of a hand-typed command line so the venv activation and the HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION / PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF exports came from the same file; started with setsid from ~/workspaces/ComfyUI

ram.note: The last number is the finding: with --lowvram --disable-smart-memory removed, the same box came back to 23.1 GiB free and swap started draining. The flags REQUIRED_FLAGS mandates are what consumed the memory that then breached REQUIRED_FLAGS' own floor.

passes.projection_at_measured_rate: 40 passes x ~557 s = ~6.2 h, versus the ~1.0 h line 10.1c item (c) is judged against
passes.note: No pass failed. The halt is pre-emptive: the third pass was already at 68% of the 900 s budget with the trend rising, and a pass that overruns it returns None, which the pre-registered >=5-failed-pass veto would then read as a property of the treatment.

other_session.evidence: 4 prompts executed between this run's pass 1 and pass 2 whose graphs load `SDXL` / `SDXLClipModel` and print the InSPyReNet `Settings -> Mode=base` banner, not this run's Qwen recompose graph — comfyui_render_on.log, the four 'Prompt executed in 32.06/19.06/18.08/18.09 seconds' entries and the `Requested to load SDXL` lines that precede them. (An earlier version of this note cited 'Inspyrenet Rembg progress lines'; the only two Rembg strings in the log are startup node-import timings.)
other_session.consequence: Their models and this run's 12.7 GB unet shared one --cache-lru 10 cache on a 31 GB box with --disable-smart-memory unloading after every prompt. The alternation is the same eviction pattern gotcha_comfyui-cache-classic-evicts-on-workflow-alternation records, with a competing session as the alternator rather than the depth graph.
other_session.ATTRIBUTION_CAVEAT: The 385.66 -> 677 -> 609 s/pass figures are NOT cleanly attributable to the flag: comfyui_render_on.log shows four interleaved prompts from a concurrent session loading SDXLClipModel + SDXL (~4.9 GB) between pass 1 and passes 2-3, and each eviction forces the 12.7 GB Qwen unet to reload. The flag and the co-tenant are confounded in this reading. What is NOT confounded is the 2026-08-17 run without the flag: 107.9 s/pass over 40 passes.

state_left_on_disk.resume_is_free: recompose_cache_path is content-addressed on (plate bytes, card paths, instructions) and recompose_run_shots skips a shot whose output already exists, so re-running `render-on` against the committed pairs.json re-does 38 passes, not 40.
state_left_on_disk.checkpoint_untouched: the harness builds its own scenes list from pairs.json and never writes the LangGraph checkpoint; run e5ed4b3a's stored shot['image_path'] values are unchanged.

to_resume: Confirm no other session is using ComfyUI (GET /queue, read the class_type lists).
Restart ComfyUI with `--lowvram --cache-lru 10` via setsid from ~/workspaces/ComfyUI. Do NOT pass --disable-smart-memory — that is what this file documents going wrong.
Close the memory competition first — on this box that means nothing else holding GB-scale RSS, since ram_free must stay above 12.0 GiB for the WHOLE run, not just at entry.
uv run python .../run_pairs.py score && uv run python .../run_pairs.py report && uv run python .../run_pairs.py grid
SUPERSEDED: This file is the record of the 2026-08-16 BLOCKED attempt only. The run completed on 2026-08-17 after `--disable-smart-memory` was removed from REQUIRED_FLAGS (107.9 s/pass, 40/40 passes). Do not follow `to_resume` — step 2 recreates the fatal config. Restart with `--lowvram --cache-lru 10` and nothing else. See README.md.
